summary: Iter 17 — Evening wrap-up push endpoint + voice-driven post creation (voice_post). Backend pytest 9/9 PASSED (test_iter17_voice_post_and_evening_wrap.py): (1) LLM voice_post 'post about the sunset at fenway park' → intent=action, target=voice_post, params.caption contains 'sunset'+'fenway'; (2) 'post about my birthday' → caption contains 'birthday'; (3) POST /api/admin/push/evening-wrap as admin returns {sent, skipped_already_today, skipped_quiet_day, errored} all ints; (4) unauth call → 401; (5) idempotency: second call returns sent=0 and skipped_already_today >= first sent; (6-9) regressions on fast-path /profile navigate, todays_highlights, admin founders codes (61), admin feed seed idempotent — all green. Frontend Playwright: logged in as admin → /feed has [data-testid=voice-fab] visible; dispatching window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('voice:create_post', {detail:{caption:'my test caption 123'}})) opens [data-testid=create-post-modal] with [data-testid=caption-input].value === 'my test caption 123' (prefill works); closing and dispatching without a caption opens modal with blank textarea value === ''. voice-fab also visible on /discover, and NOT present on /login when logged out.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 6381 lines — evening-wrap and voice/intent handlers should be extracted into dedicated routers (admin_push.py, voice.py). Carry-over from iter 15/16.

evening-wrap iterates over token_user_ids and does 3 count_documents + 1 find_one per user sequentially; fine at current scale but should be batched (aggregate) once user count grows. Also lacks pagination/limit safeguard.

evening-wrap 'quiet day' counter double-counts: users with notification_prefs.evening_wrap=False AND users with zero activity both increment skipped_quiet — consider separate skipped_disabled counter for observability.
voice/intent LLM branch uses claude-sonnet-5 with response_format-less prompting relying on regex JSON extraction — works, but adding response_format:'json' when supported would be more robust.

Feed.js CreatePostModal reads initialCaption only in useState initializer — if modal remounts with new prefill via key change it works, but if it stays mounted and prop changes, caption won't update. Currently OK since parent unmounts modal (showCreateModal toggle) each dispatch, but fragile.
seed_data_creation: none — admin feed seed idempotency verified via double POST
context_for_next_testing_agent: voice_post e2e (mic → LLM → CustomEvent → modal prefill) verified. Playwright can't invoke real Web Speech API, so the voice:create_post CustomEvent is dispatched manually — this proves the Feed.js listener + CreatePostModal.initialCaption wiring. If you need to test the VoiceAssistant.handleIntent branch, mock intentApi.classify to return {intent:'action', target:'voice_post', params:{caption:'...'}} and trigger recognition-onresult via evaluate.
